title: Megurine Luka — Happy Anniversary! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Phew...
Shall we take a break? We have sung for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I think we're at a good place to.
<Hey you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's me! I see that you're all working as hard as usual.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Luka! Hello!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What brings you here? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Not exactly, but something's about to happen!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I've actually come to invite you all to my anniversary party!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! Really? Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. It's next week.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Exactly! It's gonna be over at MEIKO's place, so I'd love for you all to be there.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course we'll be there! With gifts too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Especially as we have a lot to thank you for.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. If it weren't for what you said that time we went camping, I'm not sure what would've happened.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I think you're selling yourself too short.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I believe everyone possesses some sort of “unique talent”.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <What you're doing now is no different. I have a feeling that you'll find what you're good at once you've had a chance to learn the basics.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thanks to your words, I was able to realize what I could contribute to the team. I am truly grateful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And when I was confronted by those guys from Shepard, you went to get Toya and the others, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much for doing that, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh yes, those things did happen, didn't they?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <All I did was do and say what I thought and felt was right at the time.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But still, I'm happy to hear that I helped♪>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I like how you're so chill and relaxed, even at times like those, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too. I wish I could be like that since I often get really nervous when something's wrong.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, you flatter me. But I am an adult after all♪>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do “adults” hide in the alley to scare others?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hm? I have no idea what you're talking about.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't lie, you definitely do...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That reminds me! You said that the me in this world will be doing an anniversary show, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I saw the teaser video just yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Wait, for real? Can I see it?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure, why not? It's pretty short too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since we're all here, why don't we watch it together?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okey dokey! Playing it now!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Here we go! It's time for...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <The Luka Luka☆ “Guess That Song” Quiz♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Woohoo!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <For those of you thinking, “Oh no! I clicked on the wrong video!” Don't worry. You have not.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <This is the teaser for my upcoming anniversary show.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <As per Luka's request, we'll be doing something for this teaser video that everyone at home can join in with.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Len must be having fun.
I wanted to be the host.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Well, he did win fair and square in rock paper scissors.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Can't be helped, so we'll just have to pull our weight during the quiz!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's right! Good luck with hosting, Len!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I got this!
Alright, first things first, let's talk about how the quiz works!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'll start playing an intro to a song that I'll be singing on my anniversary.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! So those who can guess the song right will get a head start on practicing the chant for it!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <This is a song that I would love to sing together with you all, so I hope you guess it correctly.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You got it!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Alright, then let's start the quiz. Are you ready?>

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line: <Oh, actually wait! Stop the video!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Sorry for interrupting all of a sudden.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <This song intro quiz sounds really fun, so I was thinking we should do it all together♪>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, sorry, Luka. Since An and I have already watched the video, we know the answer...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, that's too bad...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, Akito and I don't know the answer. The three of us can do the quiz together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, I'm doing the quiz too?
Alright, fine. I'll do it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Really?! Thanks, Toya, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! As soon as you know the song, you've gotta say the name!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright. Understood.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Great. I'll unpause the video.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Okay! I'm gonna win!>
